1) Platform fee amortization for airgap
- Option A (capitalized approach): Treat the platform fee as a one-time onboarding + platform license that we amortize over the three-year term; for accounting purposes we can invoice 40% on signature, 30% at pilot completion, 30% at GA.
- Option B (metered smoothing): Convert platform fee to a smaller annual platform surcharge with a pledged commit; this keeps Opex treatment. We can offer both, but Option A yields a larger upfront discount.

2) SRE retainer model
- Yes. We support a named SRE retainer as an add-on. Pricing tiers: Standard (response SLA 4h, monthly health check) — $12k/mo; Dedicated (named SRE, 24x7 oncall handover windows) — $35k/mo. We can add a 12% discount if purchased as a 12-month prepay.

3) Burst capacity
- Burst pool is metered separately. Two options: burst-by-hour with a higher per-node rate, or prepaid burst credits at a discounted uplift. Both allow you to avoid re-contracting; we can cap monthly burst spend at an agreed threshold.

Next steps: David and Irene will put together an adjusted price table with a 3yr commit + the two amortization shapes, and one commercial that includes a named SRE retainer as optional line item. Can we aim to get the revised commercial by tomorrow COB?
